essence: Separation held in nearness: parted instants, pithed passing, held longing, and the final hunt — love kept unparted through parting (vv1-2, v5, v11).
Truth shown and won: body-speech-mind oneness, matched praise, melting clouds, jewel-light, ground everywhere, limb-embrace joy (vv3-4, vv6-10).

sections.SUMMARY: Separation itself becomes the method: burning to be seen (1), unparted-in-Him while parted-from-world (2), all goings as Him (3), speech matching His bliss (4), roaming desireless in His possession (5), contentment ending toil (6), things melting skyward (7), the jewel blazing from His middle (8), arrival everywhere by effortlessness (9), embrace by mere will (10) — then the single imperative: appear, with all other prayers renounced (11).

rasa.sthayibhava: śānta (tranquility) as the path bursting forth
rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is devotion (bhakti) in the mode of burning (tāpa) and seeing (paśyan); the vyabhicāri is effortlessness (anāyāsa) and contentment (santuṣṭi). The rasa is the tranquility of the path bursting forth — burning to be seen, then effortlessness.
